note: Issue 391, contacts.md section 7: the angrier of the two sour accusations - being promised is being lied to. He reaches for the last promise the PC made him that was broken, whoever broke it, and remembers_a_broken_word gates it so the letter only fires when there is a broken word to name. Kept apart from marshal.you_refused_me on purpose: a man told no and a man told yes and then let down write different letters. The Marshal because he is promised more than anyone - gold, supplies and shipments against the Crown's demands - and no governor is promised anything yet. Prose is placeholder; the final wording and every other sender belong to #368's authoring pass.

body.text: You gave me your word on {param:promised_amount} {param:promised}, {param:months_ago} months ago, and it did not come.
I had told the regiments it was coming. I have had to tell them since that it is not.
I do not write to reproach you. I write because I shall have to decide how much of your next letter to believe.
A soldier can bear being refused. He does not forget being promised.

options.text: You are right, and I do not pretend otherwise. Take this as the least I owe you.

options.text: The word was mine, but the purse was not. I will not apologise for a thing I could not do.
